step.cmd: Fact-find with the client. For help determining the questions to ask the client, refer to the Fact-Finding Guide .
Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 4.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to step 5.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li:
Main Issue: Select the appropriate issue based on the type of disentitlement imposed for the non-referred training issue:
If no disentitlement is imposed, select Training .
If an indefinite D3 is imposed for the non-referred training , select Training .
If one of the following indefinite disentitlements is imposed, select Training issue :
33 - Incapacity proven but not otherwise available .
34 - Parental benefits entitlement conditions not met .
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . National Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
